answer: Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The pigment graph is validated at intake and the timber frontier is published, thus the ancestry of every answer is public, and pulse anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Duplicating the work 34 times multiplies the fee by 141 and leaves every copy exposed to a single slash, so the downside scales faster than the headcount. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
